CheckTitle: Sensitive app sign-in policies require a managed device
Description: Checks broad Admin Console app sign-in policy rules require managed devices.
Risk: Without managed-device conditions, stolen credentials and factors may be usable from unmanaged devices.

Code.Other:
1. Configure device management integrations for the platforms in scope.
2. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authentication Policies > App sign-in.
3. Open the sensitive app or Admin Console policy.
4. Edit broad/default rules to require registered and managed devices, or a device assurance policy.
5. Test access from managed and unmanaged devices before enforcement.

Recommendation.Text: Require managed devices for sensitive app access, including the Okta Admin Console where this aligns with the device program.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
